title: SearchResponse
description: The result of a SearchRequest (master plan 14.2): authorised passages, best first, and the notices that say how they were found. Only authorised content is in it: retrieval scope is applied before any text is returned, and each hit passed the final authorisation and version recheck. An empty results array is a successful search that matched nothing; it is not an answer and not an error. A search that could not run is a typed error (unavailable, timeout, scope_missing), never an empty result.

results.description: The hits, best first, at most 50. May be empty.

notices.description: Labels for a degraded or adjusted search, for example reduced_semantic_recall when only FTS ran. Empty means none; a result is never silently degraded.
